title: Logarithmic density saving for integer quadratics admitting unit resultant with some odd-degree integer polynomial
author: Tim Browning; Stephanie Chan
work: Solubility of a resultant equation and applications
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 12 (2025), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.320
difficulty_reason: A unit resultant with an unspecified odd degree does not immediately give a coefficientwise sieve restriction independent of that degree. The authors eliminate Sylvester columns and evaluate minors to extract a rational quadratic conic whose solvability forces a prime-square discriminant/nonresidue obstruction. Computing the exclusion density1/(2p) from that new reduction supplies the nonroutine arithmetic step; the precise cited large-sieve and multiplicative estimates then produce the logarithmic saving.
